refund_policy: Evaluation fees non-refundable once the account is activated, regardless of outcome
scaling_plan: Not published as a fixed plan; launch changelog mentions a scaling program for funded traders; homepage says the $300K cap is on starting allocation, not growth
notes: No resets: breaches are permanent; buy a new evaluation. No monthly, inactivity, data, platform or withdrawal fees; Hyperliquid maker/taker fees passed through at cost plus funding rates. KYC (ID + selfie, no proof of address) required before funded account activation. Copy trading allowed incl. between own Propr accounts; opposite hedging across accounts or against external CEX/DEX accounts prohibited. Bots/API/AI agents explicitly allowed. activation_fee 0 based on 'no hidden fees' statement.
